function show(x: string | number, y: string | number) {
  if ((x = y) === (y = 3)) console.log(123);
  else console.log(x.toFixed(1));
}
function showText(x: string | number, y: string | number) {
  if ((x = y) === (y = "yes")) console.log(123);
  else console.log(x.toUpperCase());
}
show(0, String(1));
showText("", Number(1));
